domain-information: A Customer browses the catalog and compares computer models
A Customer leaves a review of their purchased computer
A Sales Associate guides customers through product options and explains key features to help them make informed choices
A Sales Associate processes purchases and coordinates deliveries to ensure customers receive their computers promptly
A Product Specialist evaluates new computer models and recommends additions to the catalog based on trends and customer feedback
A Product Specialist writes detailed descriptions and usage tips to help customers understand each model
An Inventory Manager monitors stock levels in the warehouse system and reorders popular computers to prevent shortages
An Inventory Manager updates the warehouse system when shipments arrive to keep availability accurate
An Inventory Manager tracks returns and restocks computers or accessories to maintain proper inventory
